_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiling with only 3% of 12h windows moving ±2 pts, 30d momentum stuck near 50 and longs unflushed, so no rung-breaker is present despite thin Mon/first-3 downside lean.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Denial; narrative has no explicit forward call, analyst forward is HOLD/Denial — aligned on stay-put
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed stays mid-20s to mid-30s and funding non-negative while 30d momentum holds near 50
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and Fear & Greed breaks under ~15 (drop to Panic), or momentum and Fear & Greed both lift through mid-40s (escape to Anxiety)
